name: Dev Tools
description: A lightweight dev toolset under 200KB — instant to use. Sandboxed and offline with zero network access. High-frequency tools for crypto, encoding, text, data conversion, formatting, time, networking and image generation; inputs and options are remembered and sync seamlessly across devices via DBX.
releaseNotes: 新增：Unicode 编解码面板——支持 \uXXXX、\u{4-6位}、\u{X}、U+XXXX、HTML 实体（十/十六进制）六种格式互转，编码可忽略 ASCII 字符，解码自动识别全部格式；原「Unicode 检查」更名为「Unicode 编解码」，保留逐码位分析。 | New: Unicode encode/decode panel — six formats (\uNNNN surrogate pairs, \uNNNNNN wide, \u{NNNNNN}, U+NNNN, HTML entities dec/hex) with a skip-ASCII toggle and an auto-detecting decoder; the former Unicode Inspector is now Unicode Codec, keeping the per-code-point breakdown.

zh-CN.name: Dev 工具集
zh-CN.description: 不到 200KB 的轻量开发者工具集，即开即用。沙箱离线运行，零网络权限。涵盖加解密、编解码、文本处理、数据转换、格式化、时间计算、网络运维、图像生成等众多高频工具；参数自动记忆，配置可随 DBX 跨端无缝同步。
